task: P(station's rain total in (t, t+30 min] > theta), inputs (station, prediction time t, theta)

label.definition: y = 1 if f30 > theta, f30 = sum of the station's six 5-minute readings ending t+5 ... t+30 min
label.defined_when: all six future slots reported and in the same calendar year as t
label.prediction_times: every reported 5-minute slot end t of a station

split.reason: 5-minute rain is autocorrelated within a storm; a random split puts neighbouring rows of one storm on both sides

sampling.stratum_active: r120 > 0 or f30 > 0 (station wet in the last 2 h or the next 30 min)
sampling.weights: each row weighted by 1 / its sampling rate in fitting and in every metric, so estimates refer to all prediction times

features.neighbours: 6 nearest stations by great-circle distance (station table modal coordinates), readings at the same slot t
features.no_future_inputs: every B feature uses readings with slot end <= t

A.name: A_lr
A.encoding: one-hot station, month, season, hour-of-day, theta

selection.metric: weighted log loss pooled over the threshold grid (lower is better)

baselines.name: climatology
baselines.definition: training-years frequency of y per (station, month, hour, theta), shrunk to the (month, hour, theta) frequency with 20 pseudo-counts

baselines.name: persistence
baselines.definition: training-years frequency of y per (theta, whether the last 30 min at the station exceeded theta)

test_protocol: after model choice on 2023, the chosen A and B models and both baselines are scored once on the 2024 sample; no refit, no re-tuning
